summary: Verified end-to-end that /client-portal/invoices reuses the EXACT admin DispatchInvoicesPage component, scoped to the logged-in client, with a distinguishing 'Generated by Client · <name>' badge in the admin list. Backend pytest 12/12 pass (test_iter17_client_invoice_reuse.py). Frontend Playwright: navbar has 'Invoices' (FileText) and no 'Reports'; client Invoices page renders <DispatchInvoicesPage/> with 3 seed rows (5250/5251 flagged) + Generate button. Generate dialog: Client dropdown = only 'Arseas Security Services INC'; Vendor dropdown lists 'Protos Security'; invoice number auto-filled (5253); billing period 2026-08-01→2026-08-31; Preview loads 2 line items; Save creates invoice 5253 stamped generated_by_role=client with generated_by_client_name=Arseas Security Services INC. Download PDF (Invoice-5253.pdf) + Preview PDF both work. Delete cleanup succeeded. Admin (admin@example.com) Dispatch>Invoices lists ALL invoices (4 rows) — 3 with amber 'Generated by Client · Arseas Security Services INC' badge (data-testid invoice-client-badge-{id}) and 1 admin-created row without badge. Admin Audit Log page shows Invoice entities with 'Arseas Security Services INC' client. Security: direct client calls to /api/dispatch/invoices and /api/dispatch/invoices/next-number both 403; bogus /portal/dispatch/invoices/{id} returns 404. Admin regression: normal admin invoice create sets no client flag.
critical_code_review_comments: pd_invoice_create in client_portal.py performs a second dispatch_invoices update_one() to stamp generated_by_role/client_id/client_name — this is 2 writes instead of 1. Could be inlined by passing metadata into inv.create_invoice or by post-processing in-memory. Minor perf nit.

pd_invoice_preview does NOT log to audit while pd_invoice_preview_pdf DOES — this is inconsistent. Both should either audit or not; recommend only auditing on Save + explicit PDF export (current behavior for preview PDF is fine, JSON preview correctly stays silent).
_plog silently swallows exceptions (carried over from prior iterations). A broken audit insert would go unnoticed. Recommend a logger.warning at minimum.
DispatchInvoicesPage.js line 525 badge is rendered inline below the invoice number without truncation for long client names — could push table width on narrow screens. Not blocking.

The 'Generated by Client' badge is also shown on the CLIENT's own list (they see their own generated-by-client tag). This is technically redundant for clients but matches the requirement (badge exists on client-generated invoices) and is harmless.
seed_data_creation: Created + deleted 1 invoice (#5253) during CRUD test. Admin regression test also created + deleted 1 admin invoice. Net: no residual invoices. Added audit rows (create/export/delete for invoice #5253) to dispatch_audit as expected side effect.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Invoice reuse pattern is applied identically to Wage Report (iter15) and Payment SO (iter16). Client route /client-portal/invoices -> <DispatchInvoicesPage/> under <ScopeProvider base='/portal/dispatch'>. scopedApi rewrites /dispatch/* -> /portal/dispatch/*. Backend wrappers in /app/backend/routes/client_portal.py lines 1211-1333 (pd_invoice_*). Admin router /app/backend/routes/dispatch_invoices.py has dependencies=[Depends(_block_client_role)] so direct /api/dispatch/invoices/* is 403 for role=client. Client-generated invoices are stamped generated_by_role='client' + generated_by_client_id + generated_by_client_name; badge in DispatchInvoicesPage.js line 525-532 (data-testid invoice-client-badge-{id}). Seed: Arseas has 2 invoices (5250, 5251) already flagged client. Next auto number as of run was 5253. Navbar 'Reports' item has been removed from ClientPortalLayout.js (only 'Invoices' with FileText icon remains at the bottom of navItems).
rca of the issue: No bugs found in this iteration.
